{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream crepe blouse, relaxed straight cut, long sleeves, hip-skimming length, ivory #F2EBDD, silk-blend crepe
High-waisted straight-leg trousers, full length to the ankle, deep navy #1F2A44, wool-blend twill
Single-breasted textured blazer, tailored, hip length, heather grey-taupe #8B8378, wool tweed with a soft bouclé weave
Almond-toe loafers, low block heel, burgundy #5A1F2B, smooth leather
Slim belt, simple gold-tone buckle, burgundy #5A1F2B, smooth leather
Structured medium tote, top handles, cognac #9A5B32, grained leather
Small stud earrings, round, soft gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat office band: a blouse with trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The navy trousers and soft ivory blouse make a calm base, and the taupe tweed blazer adds the autumn texture without looking heavy. The burgundy loafers and belt tie the look together and add a rich seasonal accent, while the cognac tote warms the whole palette. Everything is comfortable for a full workday and leaves the face free for the lipstick you choose yourself."}
